finalText:
All 5 tests pass now.

The bug was in `computeTotal` in `src\services\pricing.js:22`. The flat coupon amount is stored in USD, but the code subtracted it from the total after currency conversion, treating it as if it were in the target currency. A $10 coupon on a 100 EUR order was cutting 10 EUR instead of the equivalent ~9 EUR.

Fix: subtract the flat coupon amount in USD before converting to the target currency, so it converts along with the rest of the order.
